descriptions.preferred: The remarkable color tones of this plant make it a very noticeable cultivar. When they first appear, the small leaves are a bright orange-red or peach tone. As they mature, their color changes to delicate shades of pink and red with greenish undertones. Some leaves show strong yellow-green vein colors through the blend of red pink. Further into the summer, the foliage darkens somewhat and many leaves take on a faint variegation. This pattern is of minute flecking with tiny light-colored dots. The leaves have five or seven lobes, and when seven lobed the basal lobes overlap the petiole. The lobes are separated halfway to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and are ovate-lanceolate with double serration on the margins. The lobes taper quickly to a slender point. Small leaves of older wood are 2 cm long and 3 cm wide. However, the leaves on new vigorous shoots are at least twice as large. The thin petioles are 1. 5-3 cm long. This willowy, slender-twigged plant is not cascading. Occasionally, young shoots grow quite vigorously, but normal growth is rather shrubby. It makes a mediumsized plant up to 5 m at maturity, but is usually smaller. This cultivar makes a fine accent plant in small garden landscapes and lends itself very easily to container cul- Corvallis most red linearilobums, except it is the smallest member of this group, both in leaf dimensions and ultimate size. It attains only a little over 2 m high at maturity. The small five-lobed straplike leaves are 5-7 cm long and wide, with the basal lobes held at right angles or pointing slightly forward. Each lobe is 3-6 mm wide in the center with a sharp-pointed tip and fine-toothed inner margins. The slender red petioles are 1. 5-3 cm long. The young leaves are a light bronze red with green-tinged bases, rapidly becoming purple red. The red color holds well throughout the summer in full sun. This cultivar makes an unusual and attractive container plant and may be well suited to bonsai culture.

rhs.description: A willowy, relatively small cultivar with bright orange autumn leaf colour. Tapered five-lobed orange-red young leaves become peachy-yellow with shades of pink and red, before turning green with yellow-green veining, faint variegation and flecks in the summer

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性良好且排水通畅的土壤中，并选择避风位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能导致叶片焦边。亦适合盆栽，但在生长季干旱时段需特别注意浇水。
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或以软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 枝条柔垂、株型较小的品种，秋叶色鲜橙。 幼叶为先端渐尖的 5 裂叶，初展时呈橙红色，随后转为带粉色和红色调的桃黄色；入夏后变为绿色，具黄绿色叶脉，并带有淡淡斑锦和细小斑点。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 本品种最引人注目之处在于其出色的色彩层次。 小叶初展时呈鲜亮的橙红色或桃色；成熟后逐渐转为柔和的粉红和红色，并带有淡绿色底调。 有些叶片可见明显的黄绿色叶脉，在红粉色混合的叶面上格外醒目。 进入夏季后，叶色略为加深，许多叶片会出现隐约斑锦，表现为细微斑点状分布，散有极小的浅色小点。 叶片有 5 裂或 7 裂；当为 7 裂时，基部裂片与叶柄基部彼此重叠。 裂片分裂深度约达叶基的 1/2 至 3/4，形状为卵状披针形，边缘具重锯齿，且迅速渐尖成细长尖端。 老枝上的小叶长约 2 厘米、宽约 3 厘米，而强旺新梢上的叶片至少大一倍。 细叶柄长 1. 5 至 3 厘米。 植株枝条细长柔韧，呈柳枝状，但并不下垂。 幼年枝条有时生长较旺，但整体习性偏灌木状。 成熟时可形成中等大小植株，高可达 5 米，但通常更矮。 该品种适合作为小型庭园中的点景植物，也很适合容器栽培。 它与多数红叶 linearilobum 类品种相似，但本组中它的叶片尺寸和最终株型都最小，成熟时仅略高于 2 米。 其小型 5 裂带状叶长宽约 5 至 7 厘米，基部裂片近乎呈直角伸展或略向前指。 每枚裂片中部宽 3 至 6 毫米，先端锐尖，内侧边缘具细锯齿。 细长红色叶柄长 1. 5 至 3 厘米。 幼叶为浅青铜红色，基部略带绿色，很快转为紫红色；在全日照下，夏季红色保持性良好。 该品种是十分特别且美观的容器植物，也可能很适合盆景栽培。
